messages:
taylor: Quick heads up — staging showed a spike in 502s for the embed endpoint after yesterday's quant revert. Root cause: serializer header mismatch in runtime v2 build. Need a hotfix and image pin. Proposing `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-serializer:2024-07-14-hotfix`.

deploybot: Deploy request created (ID=dr-9909). Approvals needed: oncall + infra. Canary recommended: 5m. expedited=true.

rick: I can take oncall. What's the blast radius in prod?

taylor: In staging ~5% requests impacted, prod path hit ~0.6% but could amplify under batching. Rollback triggers: error_rate > 1.5% for 5m OR p95 latency > 850ms.

priya: Paste rollback steps please. Need release note link and configmap hash.

taylor: Rollback steps:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-07-10
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service
```

taylor: Release note: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/2024-07-14-embed-serializer-fix (short: serializer header mismatch after quant revert; pin image; rollback policy included). cfg-hash: `d3f9b6`.

rick: Infra +1 for a 10m midwindow at 19:12 UTC. I will open midwindow and watch consoles.

priya: I will approve after I see >=12m clean canary in staging. Any screenshots or grafana links?

taylor: Canary ran 13m clean in staging after tweak. I've attached snapshots to the release doc.

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled: dr-9909 -> prod. Canary 5m then progressive rollout. Midwindow reserved 10m starting 1730012360. Monitors: embeds.errors, embeds.p95, kvcache.miss. Watchers: rick, priya, taylor.

ops-bot: Alerting ramp set to 30s. Runbook bound: /runbooks/embed-serializer-hotfix. Pager: if embeds.errors > 1.5% for 5m -> escalate to ops-lead and open incident.

rick: Oncall ACK. I'll trigger rollback (kubectl undo) and page #incidents if thresholds breach.

taylor: Thanks team — will follow up with short blameless notes after stabilization. :thumbsup:
